propositions: After Jira create returns a key, the known key must be persisted on the still-pending RP-02 entry via record_pending_key and save BEFORE attaching the canonical label to ensure deterministic crash recovery.
The canonical rebar-id:<local_id> label must be attached before attempting the optional entity property, and property unsupported/permission failures must not remove a successful label.
Local binding confirmation via bind_confirm must occur LAST, after label attachment and property attempt, so local confirmation follows the label while the durable key was already recorded.
Any failure after create returns (label, property, or persistence) must preserve the known key, keyed-pending recovery evidence, and remote issue without deletion.
Only the RP-02 BindingStore facade may persist known keys and confirmations; no secondary binding writer shall be created.
Subsequent lifecycle intents execute only after their remote postconditions are proven.
